dogecoin.text: #Bitcoin is an alpha mindset, self taught by an individual taking the leap down the rabbit hole of money. #dogecoin is a beta mindset. The individual is lost as they are pulled into the groupthink of the ill-informed media/ masses.

So when do a brand new wave of developers / node operators start magically appearing and immediately begin to push a narrative to alter #dogecoin issuance to a fixed supply or to have less inflation? At @elonmusk behest of course. The media and clueless folks jump with glee.

The media like @Reuters @ReutersWorld @ReutersTV seems to REALLLLLLY be pushing the dogecoin articles hard as hell. Everyone should figure out why they are pushing an obvious joke and loss for most so hard.
